title: Decem Theses I: AC exemplar 1530-1540 grew; after correction, unchanged a hundred years
pass_a_gloss: I. Although the exemplar of the Augsburg Confession, first exhibited in the Year 1530, was by degrees in certain things increased and emended up to the year 1540, yet from that time in the later corrected exemplar, through a hundred years, not even a letter has been changed.
pass_b_english: I. Though the Augsburg Confession text first shown in 1530 was, in places, gradually enlarged and corrected through 1540, from that time the later corrected exemplar has not changed so much as a letter for a hundred years.
source_text:
I.
Quanquam Augustanae Confessionis exemplar, An. 1530. primùm exhibitum, ad ann. usque 1540, in quibusdam sensim auctum emendatumque fuerit, ex eo tamen tempore in posteriori correcto exemplari, per centum annos, ne litera quidem immutata est.

lemmas.gloss: not even a letter has been changed

choices.why: formal copy of the Confession, not a random sample
